Outcome: not a defect.

This issue was opened by our own crash dialog, from this repository's maintainer account. It is not a report from someone else.

What it contains: portable 1.84.0 (Release 3716). File, then Load Connections, called the tree rebuild before the connection tree had a window handle. The message says Invoke cannot run until that handle exists. The dialog says the application continued running.

Checked: the author is robertpopa22, the footer says the report is auto-generated, ...
